correctness.rationale: The p independent spherical vectors in dimension d=p+1 give the exact uniform correlation law. Rotational symmetry gives off-diagonal second and fourth moments 1/d and 3/[d(d+2)]; conditioning along a distinct four-cycle yields d^-3. Every nonzero trace-four closed walk has precisely four distinct vertices, one opposite repeated vertex, or two opposite repeated vertices, of counts p(p-1)(p-2)(p-3), 2p(p-1)(p-2), and p(p-1). The exact count and symbolic rational identity hold for all p≥2; independent fresh enumeration checked p=2..7 and the first asymptotic correction 42/p. This is an expectation only, not a concentration theorem.
residual_risks: Finite independent checks corroborate only their stated bounded domain; the universal claim depends on reconstructed analytic proof.

value.rationale: A finite-dimensional fourth spectral moment of a canonical uniform random correlation matrix is a natural statistic for covariance-prior calibration; its p-exact finite-size corrections and separation of distinct-cycle/backtracking contributions are useful beyond a generic asymptotic Marchenko–Pastur law. No general eta, fluctuations or new distribution are claimed.
residual_risks: No claims outside the expressly bounded theorem domain are accepted.
